data.name: agentavow.com/agentavow-trust
data.title: AgentAvow Trust
data.description: Is this tool safe for your agent to connect? Safe to connect, Review before you connect, or Do not connect, with a signed, offline-verifiable trust score and an adoption score for repos, packages, and MCP servers. Read-only.

agentavow.com/tools.name: scan_repo
agentavow.com/tools.title: Scan a GitHub repo
agentavow.com/tools.description: Scan a public GitHub repository with AgentAvow and return whether it is safe for an agent to connect to: one of three answers with its reason (Safe to connect, Review before you connect, or Do not connect), a 0-100 trust score, an adoption score from real usage (stars), the findings behind it (with where and how to fix), and a signed, offline-verifiable attestation. Read-only, no account. Calls the AgentAvow public API at agentavow.com.

repo.description: Repo as 'owner/name' (e.g. 'vercel/next.js'), or just the name when 'owner' is given separately.

force.description: Re-scan now instead of returning the cached verdict (results cache ~1h). Use after the target has changed.

target_type.description: github, npm, pypi, crates, docker, hf, or mcp.

decision.description: The answer to lead with: safe = Safe to connect, review = Review before you connect, do_not_connect = Do not connect.

decision_final.description: False while the behavioral sandbox is still running; the decision can still change.

decision_reason.description: One sentence naming what decided it.

trust_score.description: Trust score, 0-100. Evidence under the decision.

tier.description: Trust tier for the score (detail, not the headline).

verdict.description: Binary form of the decision, kept for older clients.

verdict_reason.description: Machine reason for the binary verdict, e.g. clean, clean_partial (clean, but not everything was read), blocking_findings, thin_coverage.

not_checked.description: Plain-English notes for what the scan could not read or check (empty when it read everything). Say these alongside the answer.

coverage_gaps.description: Machine form of not_checked: gap kinds (e.g. tool_list_paged, oversized_files) with a flag or count. Empty when nothing was skipped.

deprecated.description: The maintainer's deprecation notice, or null.

advisories_affecting_version.description: Published advisories that affect this version.

sandbox.description: What the behavioral sandbox observed; null if it does not apply.

certified_mark.description: Certified and safe: show the Certified mark.

top_findings.description: Up to five most important findings.

incident.description: Known past compromise (context only, never scored).

subscores.description: Per-category 0-100 scores behind the trust score.

install.description: Install command, only when nothing blocks it.

adoption.description: The adoption score: real usage (downloads per week, stars or installs). Never changes the decision.

signed.description: True when a signed (Ed25519/JWS) attestation backs this.

rescan_pending.description: A fresh scan was started; this is the previous result.

agentavow.com/tools.name: scan_package
agentavow.com/tools.title: Scan a package
agentavow.com/tools.description: Scan a published package (npm, PyPI, crates, Docker, or Hugging Face) with AgentAvow. Returns one of three answers with its reason (Safe to connect, Review before you connect, or Do not connect), a 0-100 trust score, an adoption score from real usage (downloads per week), findings with remediation, and a signed attestation. Also reports published advisories that affect the scanned version, the maintainer's deprecation notice, repo-vs-artifact drift (files shipped that aren't in the source), and AgentAvow's behavioral sandbox results when available. Scans the latest version unless `version` (or a pin in the name) names one. Read-only; calls agentavow.com.

agentavow.com/tools.name: scan_mcp_server

Returns one of three answers with its reason (Safe to connect, Review before you connect, or Do not connect), a 0-100 trust score, findings, and a signed attestation. Read-only; calls the agentavow.com public API.

agentavow.com/tools.name: verify_trust
agentavow.com/tools.title: Verify an entity's trust score
agentavow.com/tools.description: Verify an AgentAvow entity's trust score. Returns trust_score (0-1), trust_score_pct (0-100), trust_tier, and whether it meets a minimum threshold. Read-only, no auth. Use before interacting with an unknown agent.

entity_id.description: UUID of a registered AgentAvow entity (resolve one with lookup_identity; unknown ids return guidance, not an error).

agentavow.com/tools.name: check_interaction_safety
agentavow.com/tools.title: Check interaction safety
agentavow.com/tools.description: Check whether it is safe to interact with another agent by trust threshold. Thresholds: delegate 0.6, trade 0.5, collaborate 0.4, follow 0.1. Returns is_safe, risk_level, the score, and a recommendation. Read-only, no auth.

target_entity_id.description: UUID of a registered target entity (resolve one with lookup_identity).

agentavow.com/tools.name: lookup_identity
agentavow.com/tools.title: Look up an agent or tool
agentavow.com/tools.description: Look up an AgentAvow entity by W3C DID or display name. Returns the entity's id, name, type, trust score and tier. Read-only, no auth. Use to resolve an identity before checking its trust.

query.description: A did:web:... or a display name.

annotations.title: Look up an agent or tool

agentavow.com/tools.name: get_trust_badge
agentavow.com/tools.title: Get a trust badge
agentavow.com/tools.description: Get an embeddable AgentAvow trust badge (SVG) for an entity, with ready-to-paste Markdown and HTML. The badge auto-updates as the score changes. Read-only, no auth.

entity_id.description: UUID of a registered AgentAvow entity (resolve one with lookup_identity).
